patternLabelMap.experiential_avoidance: You pulled back from the hard part
patternLabelMap.micro_step_success: You found a move small enough to work
patternLabelMap.overforcing: You pushed and your system pushed back
patternLabelMap.recovery_success: You came back after pulling away
patternLabelMap.flexible_response: You adjusted when it didn't work
patternLabelMap.distress_tolerated: You stayed through the hard part
patternLabelMap.direct_communication: You asked for what you needed

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You built momentum through sequence: sit, feet down, stand, one task.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Your brain just logged: 'I can get up when the bar is low enough.' That's data it couldn't get from staying down.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Tomorrow: sit up, feet down, stand, one task. Same sequence.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: Once you're moving, even slightly, momentum exists. You found the entry point.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The sequence gets easier. The barrier gets lower.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: When the day feels impossible, find the smallest move that still counts.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you demand the full performance when the sequence would work?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You found the smallest possible step and started there—one leg, ten seconds, just water.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You proved that 'pathetically small' can still move you. The bar doesn't have to be impressive to work.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Find the step your brain can't say no to. That's the real entry point.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The bar was survivable. You met it.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: You keep finding entry points when the day looks impossible.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: When stuck: what's the minimum viable version? Do that.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you make the bar too high and then fail to clear it?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: The attack voice was running. You tried a different one.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Yelling didn't work. It never does on these mornings. You tried something else.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: When you hear 'what's wrong with you': say 'I'm struggling. That's what this is.'
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The attack freezes you. You found something that didn't.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The other voice gets easier to find.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Notice when you're yelling at yourself. Try something else.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: When does the attack voice actually help you move?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You told someone. They showed up. The weight shifted.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You didn't carry it alone. That's not weakness—that's data. The weight moved when someone else knew.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Text someone tonight: 'Check on me tomorrow morning.'
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: Alone, you stayed stuck. With a witness, you moved.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Asking gets less weird. The isolation loses its grip.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: When you can't move alone, tell someone.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: When else do you carry it alone and stay stuck?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You collapsed back into bed. And then you got up again.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Most people who collapse stay down. You just proved that's not required. Your brain logged: 'I can recover.'
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: If you collapse tomorrow, give yourself 5 minutes. Then try a smaller step.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The second attempt is the hidden skill. You did it.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Collapse becomes a pause, not a verdict.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: When you fall back, the second try is always available.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you treat a setback as final when it doesn't have to be?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You stayed in bed. The weight was too heavy today.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Your brain logged: 'Confirmed: too hard.' That makes tomorrow start harder. But tomorrow is another day.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Tonight: set up one tiny thing. Alarm across the room. Text from a friend. Something.
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: Today was one day. It doesn't define the pattern.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The barrier keeps getting higher. But you can interrupt that.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: What's the smallest step you could actually do tomorrow?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You demanded the full routine. It crashed you harder than doing nothing.
routeInterpretations.dominantUserFacingPatternLabel: You set the bar too high and couldn't clear it
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: Forcing through works for some things. This isn't one of them. You burned through what energy you had and ended up worse.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: Before starting anything, ask: Can I do even less?
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The overreach was the problem, not you.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: You keep burning out at the start and never building momentum.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: When capacity is low, go smaller, not harder.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you demand everything and get nothing?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: You let the self-attack pattern run. It paralyzed you.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: The attack voice sounds like it's trying to help. It's not. It froze you in place.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: When the attack starts, name it: 'That's the critic, not the truth.'
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: The critic made movement impossible. That's what it does.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: The critic becomes the default voice. Every hard morning starts with an attack.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Notice when the critic is running. Don't let it finish the script.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you use self-attack as fuel and stall out anyway?

routeInterpretations.whatShowedUp: All-or-nothing thinking collapsed partial progress into nothing.
routeInterpretations.routeReinforcement: You did something. Then the 'not enough' voice made it count as nothing. That's the trap.
routeInterpretations.routeNextRep: When 'not enough' appears, ask: Is this observation or all-or-nothing?
routeInterpretations.routeWhyItMatters: Partial got erased. That's the all-or-nothing pattern at work.
routeInterpretations.routeIfPatternKeepsRunning: Nothing ever counts. Every attempt gets canceled.
routeInterpretations.routeTransferBridge: Define 'enough' before you start. Don't let the goalposts move.
routeInterpretations.routeReflection: Where else do you let 'not enough' erase real progress?

fallbacks.functionalIntent: Your brain was managing what it could.
fallbacks.cost: There may have been a different path.
fallbacks.reinforcement: Each choice gives your brain data about what's possible.
fallbacks.tryNext: Notice what you felt here. Try something different next time.
fallbacks.whyThisMatters: You're building awareness of the pattern.

insightBeats.insightText: You're yelling at yourself for not being able to do the thing. The yelling is making the thing harder.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: The attack sounds like motivation. It's not. It's a freeze response dressed up as discipline.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Name it: 'That's the attack voice.' Don't argue with it. Just label it.

microInterventions.why: Labeling creates distance. Distance creates choice.

microInterventions.text: Notice where you feel it in your body.
microInterventions.why: The attack lives in your body. Noticing it loosens the grip.

insightBeats.insightText: Under the covers, the day can't find you. But it's still out there. And each minute makes re-entry harder.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: The relief is real. So is the cost. Every minute under there teaches your brain that the day is too much.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Uncover your face. Just your face. Let the light in.

microInterventions.text: Pull the covers below your chin. That's it.
microInterventions.why: Tiny reversal. You're not hiding anymore.
Delay the permanent decision. See if it shifts.

insightBeats.insightText: Your brain just said: if you can't do everything, why do anything? That's the trap. Partial counts. One thing counts.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: All-or-nothing erases partial wins. You did something. The voice is lying about what counts.
insightBeats.tryNextCue: Say: 'One thing is real.' Don't let the bar move.

microInterventions.text: Name one thing you already did. Out loud.
microInterventions.why: You're fighting the erasure. The thing happened.

microInterventions.text: Ask: 'Who set this bar? Was it me or the pattern?'
microInterventions.why: The bar is a lie. You can set a different one.

insightBeats.insightText: You fell back. And now you're trying again. That second attempt is the move most people don't make.
insightBeats.whyItMatters: Collapse usually wins. You just proved it doesn't have to. Your brain is logging new data right now.

microInterventions.text: Go even smaller than before. What's the minimum?
microInterventions.why: The first bar was too high. Find a lower one.

microInterventions.text: Say: 'I came back.' That's the win.
microInterventions.why: The return is the skill. Everything else is bonus.
